blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Some call center agents, whose graveyard shift forces them to adjust their body clock to sleep during the day, chose to forego their daytime slumber and join Monday’s anti-corruption march, which began at Liwasang Bonifacio. Kean Kumalat, one of 47 members of the BPO Industry Employees Network Philippines (BIEN) chapter in Cubao, is among several dozens of call center workers who joined thousands of protesters in the freedom park to mark the 54th anniversary of martial law declaration as well as the second iteration of the anti-corruption protests prompted by the multibillion flood control corruption scandal.
